name: MCN1
tagline: Compact Intel mini PC with dual HDMI 2.0 and flexible SATA storage
description: MCN1 pairs Intel N95 / N100 / N150 options with one DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM slot for 8-16 GB. Dual HDMI 2.0 outputs, four 10 Gbps USB 3.2 ports and Gigabit Ethernet connect displays, peripherals and the network. M.2 SATA storage, an optional 7 mm 2.5-inch drive and selectable wireless configurations provide expansion choices; TPM 2.0 is supported.
featureHeading: Compact desktop connections and clear configuration choices
advantageSummary: Compare the memory, display, storage and wireless options for this model, including TPM 2.0 support and the listed power and environment limits.

fr.tagline: Mini-PC Intel compact avec deux HDMI 2.0 et stockage SATA évolutif
fr.description: MCN1 associe Intel N95 / N100 / N150 à un emplacement DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM pour 8-16 Go. Deux sorties HDMI 2.0, quatre ports USB 3.2 à 10 Gbit/s et Ethernet Gigabit relient écrans, périphériques et réseau. Le stockage M.2 SATA, un disque 2,5 pouces de 7 mm en option et des configurations sans fil au choix offrent des possibilités d'extension ; TPM 2.0 est pris en charge.

it.tagline: Mini PC Intel compatto con due HDMI 2.0 e archiviazione SATA flessibile

Due uscite HDMI 2.0, quattro USB 3.2 a 10 Gbps ed Ethernet Gigabit collegano display, periferiche e rete. M.2 SATA, un disco da 2,5 pollici alto 7 mm opzionale e configurazioni wireless a scelta offrono espansione; TPM 2.0 è supportato.
